d:
Pakistan ne dava kiya hai ki usne suparsonik misail fatah-3 ka saphal parikshan kiya hai. pakistani sena ke intar sarvisez pablik rileshans yani aaeeespiaar ka kahna hai ki yah misail edvans nevigeshan aur propalshan sistam se lais hai. sath hi suparsonik gati se lanbi duri ke lakshyon par satik aur ghatak prahar karne men saksham hai. is misail ki tulna bharat ki suparsonik misail brahmos se bhi ki ja rahi hai. fatah-3 men kya khasiyat hain aur kya ye vaqaee bharat ki brahmos misail jaisi hai?
